title: TLS verification override configured (java) — review required
description: Certificate or hostname verification is switched off in java: ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER. The connection then trusts any certificate, so an active attacker intercepts credentials, tokens, and data. This lexical rule flags the switch; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or restores verification.
remediation: Delete the switch and verify against the system store (the strict hostname verifier); for private CAs, pin the CA instead of disabling checks.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the switch regardless of environment. Per-client verify=False forms are separate rules.
